symbols: ADR-1 — Cross-provider session handoff is a lossy metadata bridge, not a resume
ADR-2 — Session preview is a second sanctioned, bounded transcript reader
ADR-3 — Narrowing the read-only credential-store invariant to permit the `rebind` write path
ADR-4 — Delegating OAuth token refresh to Claude Code instead of performing the grant
ADR-5 — Pet overlay window lives inside the GUI shell (macOSPrivateApi accepted)

health.formula: Score = sum of four parts, 25 points each, each part loses its points linearly up to a limit: dead = 25 × (1 − min(1, dead code files / scope files ÷ 0.20)); cycles = 25 × (1 − min(1, file cycles ÷ (2 % of scope files))); guesses = 25 × (1 − min(1, guessed edge share ÷ 0.30)); hotspots = 25 × (1 − min(1, hotspot files / scope files ÷ 0.05)), a hotspot being a code file with at least 20 commits in the git window and at least 500 lines. Grade A ≥ 80, B ≥ 60, C ≥ 40, D ≥ 20, else F — withheld while any part is missing.

verbs.name: query
verbs.answers: Which symbols match a name, kind or relation filter — with witness and population line
verbs.input: a name, kind or relation filter
verbs.output: matching symbols, each with its witness, and the population line
verbs.guarantee: only indexed facts; what the index does not hold is said, not guessed

verbs.name: explain
verbs.answers: The two-hop neighbourhood of one symbol (callers, callees, members), never generated prose
verbs.output: its callers, callees and members within two hops, with witnesses
verbs.guarantee: a graph query: no generated prose, every line is a fact

verbs.name: affected
verbs.answers: What reaches a symbol or the files changed since a rev
verbs.output: the symbols and files that reach it
verbs.guarantee: walks accepted edges only; guessed links are marked

verbs.name: path
verbs.answers: The shortest stated path between two symbols
verbs.output: the shortest stated path, one edge per step
verbs.guarantee: no step without a recorded edge

verbs.name: impact
verbs.answers: Callers, dependents and test files a diff can break
verbs.output: callers, dependents and test files of the changed symbols
verbs.guarantee: the graph names candidates; the source decides

verbs.name: tests-for
verbs.answers: The test files that exercise a symbol
verbs.output: the test files that import or exercise it
verbs.guarantee: only tests the graph links to the symbol

verbs.name: untested
verbs.guarantee: absence is reported against the indexed tests only

verbs.name: dead
verbs.answers: Symbols nothing reaches, refused where the graph cannot tell
verbs.guarantee: refuses where the graph cannot tell

verbs.name: review-risk
verbs.answers: A diff as a sum of terms — callers, entry points, flows, co-change partners, areas, columns, operations, pipelines — each fact with its witness
verbs.guarantee: every term is a fact with its witness; no model, no hidden term

verbs.name: why
verbs.answers: Every path from a declaration to a package, read from the lockfiles
verbs.output: one line per path, root declaration first
verbs.guarantee: lockfiles only; no package manager runs

verbs.name: usage
verbs.answers: Which of a package's public names the code uses, of how many
verbs.output: the share, the call sites and the flows reaching them
verbs.guarantee: a share only with the package installed; otherwise "surface unknown"

verbs.name: remove-plan
verbs.answers: What removing a package touches: call sites, non-import uses, dependents, packages leaving with it, tests
verbs.guarantee: never a verdict: dynamic use is invisible to a file reader

verbs.name: provenance
verbs.answers: Since when an element exists, and for which commit, PR and ticket — or what a ticket or PR introduced
verbs.input: a ticket key, a PR number, a file or a symbol
verbs.output: introduced, last changed, a timeline; for a ticket the files and routes it introduced
verbs.guarantee: local history only; ticket and PR text is never read or stored

verbs.name: confirm
verbs.answers: Whether the witnesses of an answer still hold in the working tree: confirmed, moved, changed or gone
verbs.output: confirmed, moved, changed or gone per witness
verbs.guarantee: reads the working tree, not the index

verbs.name: pack
verbs.answers: A verified context pack for a task within a token budget, each item at file:line
verbs.input: a task in words, a token budget
verbs.output: items with rank, reason and file:line, cut by rank at the budget
verbs.guarantee: each item re-read against the working tree before it is returned
